text:
nina: Heads-up - ops noticed a spike where requests with `X-Embed-Units` are being forced to conservative route even though `X-Embed-Dims` and payload-size look fine. Seems client churn is leaking experimental headers. Need a quick decision on backcompat + console visibility.

dev: Do we know which version of the SDKs started adding `X-Embed-Units`? Could be a canary client.

omar: Looks like a mix. Some versions emit a number, others emit a JSON array when multiple texts are batched. Router currently treats any non-scalar as parse error -> conservative.

pat: Can we make the router tolerant and accept arrays by summing? Risky but might reduce unnecessary safe routing.

nina: I want telemetry first. Proposal: 1) Patch ingress to attempt a tolerant parse but do NOT change routing decision unless an env flag is set. 2) Emit `ingress.header.x_embed_units.present`, `x_embed_units.parse=(ok|array_ok|fail)`, `ingress.route.chosen=(fast|conservative|fallback)`. 3) Add console card per-tenant showing percent routed conservative due to units-parse-fail.

omar: I can land tolerant parse in canary: if header is CSV/JSON array of ints, compute sum and tag `x_embed_units.parse=array_ok` but leave route unchanged unless `HONOR_X_UNITS=true`.

dev: For console UX: add a toggle "Honor client-provided embed units" (default OFF). Tooltip: "Only enable if clients use SDK >= vX and emit integer unit estimates consistently." Also show a histogram of `x_embed_units.parse` outcomes and top SDK versions.

pat: Rollout plan: canary parse-only today, 72h telemetry. Dogfood internally with toggle ON for 48h. Then 0.5% tenant opt-in for 7 days with gating: parse_fail_rate < 0.3% and median p95 latency delta < 8ms. If either fails -> revert toggle.

nina: Also add alerts: `x_embed_units.parse:fail rate > 0.3% over 15m` -> page eng-oncall. And `route.conservative:increase > 10% in 5m` -> page infra.

omar: DevEx: can you make SDK change to normalize header? If multi-input, either send summed scalar or omit header. That will make toggling safe.

dev: Yep, we've queued a patch for js/go/python sdks to normalize behavior and emit it in next patch release. We'll also add a client-side preflight to avoid sending ambiguous headers.

infra-bot: Created ticket ENG-embed-units-telemetry and linked canary traces.

pat: One more thing - console should not expose raw headers. Show anonymized samples and counts only. Security/privacy confirmed with legal.

nina: Owners: Omar (runtime), Pat (console), DevEx (SDK). I'll write the rollout doc and add the alert thresholds.

omar: Landing canary parse tags now. Will push `x_embed_units.parse` + `ingress.route.chosen` metrics.

dev: I'll coordinate SDK patch and announce to customers.

nina: Thanks team. After 72h of telemetry we'll reconvene and decide whether to enable `HONOR_X_UNITS` behind console toggle.
